Aftermath
Following the engagement, KLA forces maintained control of the immediate area and used the outcome to strengthen their presence in the surrounding villages. The clash boosted local recruitment and morale for the KLA and disrupted Yugoslav security operations in the region for a limited period. Yugoslav forces later regrouped and launched broader operations, but the specific engagement is remembered in KLA historiography as a tactical success.
